name: Yavapai County, AZ
findings: Yavapai County has 851 nonprofit organizations. 365 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 285 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Yavapai County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 67 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 67 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
